verdict.rationale: Workers' developer tooling, the Wrangler CLI and the workerd-powered simulator, is published as source in the public cloudflare/workers-sdk GitHub repository, which also links the workerd runtime repo, so parts of the product's source are readable. No evidence states the license terms, and nothing shows the hosted platform's source is open. Missing for 10: an explicit open-license statement (e.g. Apache/MIT) for workers-sdk and workerd, evidence covering the runtime itself rather than just tooling, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: A command line tool for building [Cloudflare Workers](https://workers.cloudflare.com/).
A simulator for developing and testing Cloudflare Workers, powered by [workerd](https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd)
